text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Jc Elijah Bawuah has resigned from the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee effective December 12, 2021. If you have any questions about this update, please contact the Public Appointments Secretariat at appoint@toronto.ca or 416-397-0088.
The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee received the item for information.
